page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon Platinum 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, providing 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 8 physical cores with 2 threads per core. Memory allocation stands at 64.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. The CPU configuration includes 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and a 35 MB shared L3 cache, with instruction set support for AVX, AVX-512F, and AVX-512 VNNI alongside AES acceleration. It does not include dedicated GPU accelerators, bundled local storage, or complimentary public IPv4 addresses, relying entirely on network-attached storage and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Benchmark results position the ecs.g6.4xlarge consistently in the middle 50% across multi-core and memory workloads, while single-core compute performance exhibits relative limitations. In raw processing tests, the instance registered a stress-ng multi-core score of 13974.04 and a PassMark CPU score of 15381.15. Conversely, single-threaded execution demonstrated lower throughput, with stress-ng single-core scoring 1310.38 and gzip single-threaded compression reaching 22.76 GB/sec, placing both in the bottom 25%. Geekbench testing returned a single-core score of 1162.0 and a multi-core score of 7205.0, accompanied by average-tier results in Clang compilation (12441.0), ray tracing (11175.0), and image processing (6364.0).

Memory and application-level benchmarks indicate reliable data throughput for parallelized services. The instance achieved 779.61 GB/sec on cached read-only 16 KB memory transfers, with large-block 256 MB operations measuring 89.18 GB/sec for reads and 46.34 GB/sec for writes. PassMark database operations reached 5576.02, while Redis throughput recorded 13.43 million SET operations per second and static web serving delivered 11.32 GB/sec. Across these tests, system performance tracks firmly within the middle tier.

Given its balanced compute-to-memory configuration and moderate networking throughput, the ecs.g6.4xlarge provides stable resource density for enterprise applications that do not depend on single-thread peak performance. Workloads best aligned with this instance profile include multi-threaded web serving, containerized application clusters, intermediate caching layers, build and compilation pipelines, and relational or document database engines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine provisioned with 16 vCPUs (8 physical cores, 2 threads per core) on a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor and 64.0 GB of memory. Operating under KVM virtualization, it includes support for AVX-512 instruction sets, 5 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, zero local storage, and no GPU accelerators. Benchmark evaluations place the server within the mid-tier category across multi-core metrics, achieving a Geekbench multi-core score of 7205.0, a PassMark CPU score of 15381.15, and 13.43 million Redis SET operations per second. However, single-core metrics fall into lower percentiles, shown by a stress-ng single-core score of 1310.38 and a Geekbench single-core score of 1162.0. With its 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, the ecs.g6.4xlarge fits multi-threaded enterprise services, web application tiers, CI/CD compilation pipelines, and mid-range caching workloads.
